information: Welcome to Norwegian FMC Championship 2026! This year we are holding the Fewest Moves event separely from the Norwegian Championship. This means that, we have enough time to do three attempts (mean of 3) and declare a true Norwegian champion in the event. To include as many people as possible, the competition will be held in four different cities at the same time: * Skjetten * Trondheim * Bergen (Åsane) * Sandnes ## Please note that this competition does not hold the regular 3x3 event
